description: Android via Capacitor (Phase 3). Add Capacitor to the EXISTING React frontend (no second UI), make the shared axios client platform-aware (native uses a configured Device-A base URL, web stays relative), add a QR scanner service + native-only Scan button reusing existing share/business logic, and configure Android permissions + cleartext for http LAN sharing. Generate the native project (expected BLOCKED: Android SDK/ANDROID_HOME/gradle/adb all absent) and document the exact APK build + keystore signing steps. Verify what IS possible here (npm run build, tsc --noEmit, lint all exit 0); report cap add android result + APK as BLOCKED. Depends on FEAT-001 (diagnostics/share contract) and FEAT-002 (desktop packaging done first per task ordering).
steps: Add @capacitor/core, @capacitor/cli, @capacitor/android as devDeps in frontend/package.json; cd frontend; npm install; npx cap init "Universal QR Sharing" "com.universalqr.sharing" --web-dir=dist; create frontend/capacitor.config.ts.

Make the shared client platform-aware in frontend/src/api/client.ts: on Capacitor.isNativePlatform() use the configured base URL (reuse the existing localStorage key qrshare_api_base_url, entered via SettingsPage 'API Base URL', e.g. http://172.20.10.2:8787); on web keep relative ''. Android is a CLIENT reusing the SAME React UI + API client — no duplicated business logic. Keep frontend/src/api/files.ts and existing pages unchanged in behavior.

Add a Capacitor barcode-scanner plugin (devDep, pick a maintained one) and frontend/src/services/scanner.ts exposing scan(): Promise<string> (native uses plugin, web throws a clear not-supported error). Add a native-only ScanQrButton component (gate on Capacitor.isNativePlatform()) wired into an existing page (e.g. HomePage.tsx) that parses the result: share URL http://<ip>:<port>/share/<token> -> set host base + open the in-app share view; plain URL -> open browser; text/JSON/number -> display.

Configure Android permissions + cleartext: CAMERA + network only; set android:usesCleartextTraffic="true" in AndroidManifest.xml (REQUIRED for http LAN, document as a deliberate scoped decision); optional network_security_config.xml restricting cleartext to private IP ranges. These are generated under frontend/android/ by cap add; if that is blocked, author them as documented templates under android/ or inside docs/android.md.

Generate the native project: cd frontend; npm run build; npx cap add android; npx cap sync android. cap add android may fail without the SDK — EXPECTED. Capture the EXACT error. Do NOT download the multi-GB SDK. Document ANDROID SDK as BLOCKED.

Write docs/android.md and android/BUILD-ANDROID.md with EXACT APK build steps, keystore generation via keytool, and signing config via env vars (never commit a keystore). State clearly that the APK build is BLOCKED here (SDK absent, no device/emulator).
acceptance_criteria: cd frontend; npm run build exits 0, npx tsc --noEmit reports 0 errors, npm run lint reports 0 warnings — with Capacitor + scanner code present.
frontend/src/api/client.ts selects base URL by platform (native=configured, web=relative) without duplicating business logic; existing pages/API functions unchanged in behavior.
A native-only Scan button + scanner.ts exist and parse share-URL vs plain-URL vs text/JSON/number; web path throws a clear not-supported error.
AndroidManifest (or template) requests only CAMERA + network and sets usesCleartextTraffic=true with a documented rationale.
docs/android.md + android/BUILD-ANDROID.md give exact APK + keystore steps and honestly mark the APK build BLOCKED; the cap add android outcome is recorded verbatim, not faked.
verification: cd frontend; npm install; npm run build  (exit 0)
cd frontend; npm run lint  (0 warnings)
cd frontend; npx cap add android  — capture the exact outcome (success OR the precise SDK-missing error) and record it; do not fabricate.
blocked_reason: APK Gradle build BLOCKED here: no Android SDK (ANDROID_HOME/ANDROID_SDK_ROOT empty, no adb) and installed JDK is 25 which the Capacitor Gradle wrapper 8.11.1 rejects ('Unsupported class file major version 69'). cap add/sync themselves succeeded. Per task constraints the multi-GB SDK was not downloaded.
findings:
Implemented FEAT-003 (Android via Capacitor), reusing the SAME React UI + API client (no duplicated business logic). Changes: added @capacitor/core, @capacitor-mlkit/barcode-scanning (deps) + @capacitor/cli, @capacitor/android (devDeps), all resolved to 7.x (core/cli/android 7.6.9, mlkit 7.5.0); npm install OK. npx cap init 'Universal QR Sharing' com.universalqr.sharing --web-dir=dist created frontend/capacitor.config.ts (added android.allowMixedContent for LAN http). Made frontend/src/api/client.ts platform-aware via Capacitor.isNativePlatform(): native uses configured base URL from existing localStorage key qrshare_api_base_url (set in SettingsPage), web stays relative ''; native with no host configured fails fast with a clear message. api/files.ts and existing pages unchanged in behavior. Added frontend/src/services/scanner.ts (scan(): Promise<string> + parseScan classifying share-URL vs plain-URL vs JSON vs number vs text; web throws ScannerNotSupportedError) and native-only frontend/src/components/ScanQrButton.tsx (gated on isNativePlatform, renders null on web) wired into HomePage.tsx; share URL sets host base + opens /share/:token, plain URL opens browser, json/number/text pre-fill TextQrPage via router state. Authored Android permission/cleartext TEMPLATES under android/templates/ (AndroidManifest.additions.xml = CAMERA+INTERNET+ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE only, camera optional, usesCleartextTraffic=true documented; network_security_config.xml scoping cleartext to private IPs). Added frontend/android/ and .gradle/ to root .gitignore (Capacitor-generated native project not committed).

VERIFICATION (all actually executed):
- npm run build => exit 0 (vite built dist/, incl web.js scanner web shim chunk).
- npx tsc --noEmit => 0 errors (after fixing IsSupportedResult.supported property name).
- npm run lint => 0 warnings (--max-warnings 0).
- npx cap add android => SUCCESS, exit 0: 'android platform added!' (found plugin @capacitor-mlkit/barcode-scanning@7.5.0). NOT blocked, contrary to context prediction.
- npx cap sync android => SUCCESS, exit 0: 'Sync finished'.
- ./gradlew assembleDebug (actual APK build attempt) => FAILED, exit 1: 'BUG! exception in phase semantic analysis ... Unsupported class file major version 69' (JDK 25 vs Gradle 8.11.1) AND no Android SDK present. APK BUILD BLOCKED — not faked, no APK produced. docs/android.md + android/BUILD-ANDROID.md document exact APK + keytool signing steps and mark APK build BLOCKED honestly with both root causes (SDK absent + JDK too new, use JDK 17).
